request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER

layers.text: Add only a pattern on the hide: six big dark navy leopard rosettes, colour #131c3a, each a thick dark ring round a slate-blue centre, about as big as its eye: three on the back and flank, one on the thigh, two on the tail, wide apart. The head, belly and lower legs stay plain. Do not redraw anything. Keep the amber-orange crest, the cream belly, the eyes, teeth, claws, pose, proportions, black outline and style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
